scope: Source-free metadata and proposed causal rules only. No financial observation values, target data, feature matrix, model fits, metrics, downloaded weights or source document copies.

classification_definitions.A: Trusted dated primary history with sufficiently supported publication and nonrevision/vintage semantics. Explicit official-archive trust; no independent historical SHA.
classification_definitions.B: Historical values exist, but historical release timing or version/revision semantics remain incomplete. Exploratory/sensitivity only; a fixed delay does not promote B to A.
classification_definitions.C: Historical availability cannot be reliably reconstructed for the proposed series/construction. Excluded from final causal evaluation.

classification_scope: The class describes the exact source route and series definition audited here, not every possible representation of the economic indicator.

temporal_protocol.target_period: 2023-01 through 2024-12; monthly category Все категории by municipality
temporal_protocol.target_availability: L=0 is an assumption; original target publication timestamps and historical revisions remain unverified.
temporal_protocol.existing_date_conventions: E05c uses timezone-free month-end dates; news_features converts month-end to 00:00 Europe/Moscow of the last calendar day, then UTC.
temporal_protocol.proposed_e08b_cutoff: Use an explicit timestamp at last calendar day 00:00 Europe/Moscow for the new financial layer, consistent with existing news parsing. This is a recommendation, not an executed feature protocol or a change to frozen E05c.
temporal_protocol.admission: An observation/announcement must be known by own r (O for current forecast) and its selected vintage must be available then. For in-force rate/FX levels require effective_at<=r; a known future-effective announcement can only be a separately named announcement feature.
temporal_protocol.date_only_release: If a verified release has only a date, conservative available_at is next calendar day 00:00 Europe/Moscow; do not invent an exact intraday publication time.
temporal_protocol.effective_date_upper_bound: For official FX published before its effective date, effective-date midnight is a conservative upper bound, not a claimed actual publication timestamp.
temporal_protocol.unknown_timestamp: published_at=null or unknown remains unknown. A modelled release delay is sensitivity evidence, not proof of a historical release.
temporal_protocol.historical_training: Build each historical pair's information set at its own r; a later version available on training O cannot be backfilled to r.
temporal_protocol.financial_prehistory: 2022 minimum for daily/event rolling windows. For monthly YoY at early-2023 origins after release delay, 2021 denominators may be required; otherwise preserve missingness.
temporal_protocol.geography: Audit shortlist is national. Copying a national signal across 2190 municipalities does not create 2190 independent temporal observations. Regional/municipal use requires separately audited timing and year-aware mapping.
temporal_protocol.causal_meaning: Causal backtest means information-feasible time ordering, not identification of the indicator's economic causal effect.

e05c_overlap.partial_news_overlap: E07a v3 already contains trusted key-rate decision cores; key-rate changes are the same events, while numerical levels and cumulative changes are new representations. Do not count them as independent news evidence.
e05c_overlap.rejected_rebranding: Reusing annual inflation/consumption forecasts or current-vintage wage/CPI workbooks is not new E08 leading financial information.
e05c_overlap.real_early_warning: Financial indicators do not add target months or independent onset dates. Existing insufficiency of real temporal labels remains; no classifier is authorized by this audit.

optional_families.reason: Optional scope omitted to prioritize six required financial families. Strong additional vintage evidence and an incremental information rationale would be needed; no new source-quality verdict for these optional series.
